question: How many 2015-vintage loans not flagged as first-time homebuyer loans defaulted? (This group includes refinances.)

args.query: SELECT loans, defaults, default_rate FROM segments WHERE dimension = 'first_time_homebuyer' AND vintage = 2015 AND bucket = 'N'

content.text: For 2015-vintage loans not flagged as first-time homebuyer loans (bucket 'N'), there were **270** defaults out of 41,070 loans (a default rate of 0.66%).
